Your organization's team: list members, add people, change roles, remove people.

Usage:
  voidhash member <command> [flags]

Aliases:
  member, members

Commands:
  list       List an organization's members and their roles.
  invite     Add someone with a Voidhash account to the organization as a member.
  role       Make an admin a member.
  remove     Remove someone from the organization.

Flags:
  -h, --help  Show help for this command

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Run 'voidhash member <command> --help' for more about a command.
